title: Brass band with Kid Punch, Black Benny and Zeb
summary: Keppard played alto in his brass band with Black Benny, Henry Martin, Zeb and Kid Punch, whom he rates as having a stronger lift than Freddie.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: yeah, I played alto with him, the brass band, was Black Benny, was playing bass drum, and Henry Martin, was playing kilo drum, Zeb was playing clarinet, that's in the brass band, who's the clarinet? Zeb,

Zeb was playing clarinet, and, uh, this here, a fellow here, was playing, uh, he was playing, uh, didn't I mention, uh, Punch, was playing, and Punch would take a whole band by himself, no other trumpet, no other trumpet, he'd take it by himself, but the trumpet don't come, he, he, he, he got him, and take it all by himself, and he hold it down, he got a heavy lift, he got a strong lift, was he as powerful as your brother? oh, well, I tell you, I, well, I believe Punch, had a better lift than my brother, yeah, my brother is the kind of a, uh, almost like, I don't know, mid-to-air, but I don't know, mid-to-air with a sweet kind of plent, but Freddie had, a pretty good lift, but I believe Punch, Punch had a strong lift than him, and, uh, well Punch, was, he just come up in his, uh, well, it did, you know, but, you know, it's just not like anything else, when you, when you're a young man, you can do more than an old man can do, you understand? yeah, sometimes, yeah, sometimes, that's right, so I know that well, well, yeah, he was playing with, uh, Jack Kerrig, well, Frank Ducey, he had this fella that called, uh, oh, he probably used to play, uh, he probably used to play guitar, well, nevertheless, I can't remember his name, and, uh, I can't remember who his name was playing with, uh, Frank, Frank Ducey, but I know Bob Lyons used to play with him, and I know this other fella, Dan, Dan, Dandy, he used to play bass with Frank Ducey, Lewis, is his name Lewis, maybe? no, you mean, which one is that?
